column2: Choose a theological school

In the liturginen faith, there are two theological schools: St. Michael Agricola and St. Bridget of Sweden. Both schools named as patrons two important figures in the history of Scandinavian Christianity: a Catholic nun and a Protestant translator. Both also represent different views on ecclesiastical and theological issues. Each member of the Liturginen Church must choose between the two, as this determines the type of religious practice they choose.

Organise Summer Services

Summer Services are annual gatherings of Laestedians held in the summer and lasting four days. During these four days, Laestedians participate in numerous sermons and sing devotional hymns and songs. Organising such a gathering is a unique opportunity to demonstrate one's piety and faith in the message of Reverend Lars Levi Laestadius.
